title: Hathor merge-mining hashrate collapses ~3,500x
summary: Hathor's chain difficulty fell ~3,500-fold within two days of 2026-06-10, leaving only a residual F2Pool hashrate slice unlikely to clear Bitcoin's target.
body:
Starting June 10 between 12:00 and 14:30 UTC, Hathor block weight (log2 difficulty) dropped from ~68.7 to a 56.9 floor over two days (~11.8 bits less work per block).[^1]

F2Pool still merge-mines Hathor with `/F2Pool/` coinbases on live Bitcoin templates, but at the residual ~5–7 PH/s a Bitcoin-difficulty parent is expected roughly once every few years vs ~40/month pre-collapse.[^2]

The source's stale badge reflects this hashrate drop rather than a monitor fault; the last Bitcoin-difficulty parent (Hathor `6,631,349`, Bitcoin `953,043`) landed ~10 hours before the collapse.

figures.caption: Hathor block weight before, during, and after the June 2026 collapse.
figures.accessible_summary: Hathor block weight held near 68.7 until falling 11.8 bits (~3,500x less work) between June 10 and June 12, 2026 to a 56.9 floor.
